subject: Billing intake: proposed ACK token design and portal/email fallback
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmetools.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier billing intake — onboarding form + email fallback?

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking a look — we're getting close to go-live for Acme Tools (POs will start next month) and I want to confirm the billing intake expectations so our AP team doesn't miss payments. Two quick questions:

1) Portal vs email: We prefer to use your portal, but some of our legacy partners will still send PDFs to an AP inbox for the first 60 days. If we fall back to email, what exact subject line and header fields do you need so your ingest honors PO stamping and routing?

2) ACK / receipt: Does Redwood emit an acknowledgement token on email ingestion? If so, can you share the format so we can wire it into our system?

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (PDF), sample_invoice_template.xlsx (XLSX) — sample lines included.

A couple constraints from our side:
- Invoice filenames are auto-generated by our ERP (no manual edits)
- We must include the Redwood PO number in the invoice header but the ERP sometimes puts it in a free-text field

Can you confirm the minimum required fields and an example email subject/header we should use? Happy to do a 20-minute call if that helps.

Thanks,
Lara Chen
Procurement Operations
Acme Tools
lara.chen@acmetools.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmetools.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier billing intake — onboarding form + email fallback?

Hi Lara — great questions, thanks for sending the attachments. Short answers up front: portal preferred; email fallback allowed if it conforms to the headers/subject pattern below; yes, we will return an ACK token on successful ingestion. Details and next steps below.

Portal (preferred)
- Best path for reliability and PO matching. Portal submission auto-parses PO lines and attaches an ingested ID.
- Recommended: onboarding_form_v2 + SFTP/SaaS portal.

Email fallback (requirements)
- Subject prefix: REDWOOD-INVOICE <vendor_id> <po_number>
  - Example: REDWOOD-INVOICE ACME-12345 PO-987654
- Required headers (in body or PDF meta):
  - Redwood PO#: PO-XXXXXX
  - Vendor ID: ACME-12345 (we'll provide)
  - Invoice date and gross amount
- If the PO is only in a free-text ERP field, include a one-line header at top of email body: PO: PO-987654

ACK token behavior (what we'll emit)
- On successful ingest we return an ACK token to the sender address in the form: RW-ACK-<YYYYMMDD>-<8hex>
- We will also post the ACK token into the portal record if the invoice arrived via portal.
- If the invoice fails parsing (no PO, ambiguous vendor ID) we send a failure notice with an error code and next steps.

Attachments: I attached a short spec (ack_token_spec.txt) and a cleaned sample template based on your XLSX. Please confirm you can produce the subject prefix and include the PO line in the email body if the ERP doesn't put it into the PDF header.

Next steps
- If ok, let's schedule a 20 min ops call tomorrow to lock the subject prefix and sample ACK handling.
- Please return the completed vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf with your preferred vendor ID field filled.

Thanks — I looped in Karthik for routing/policy details and Monica for PO mapping to ledger codes.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: ack_token_spec.txt (text), sample_invoice_template.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier billing intake — onboarding form + email fallback? (internal ops notes)

Internal notes / proposed playbook before tomorrow's ops call with Acme:

1) Routing policy (Karthik)
- Portal entries -> route to Invoice Parser v3 (primary).
- Email fallback -> first-pass regex extract of subject prefix REDWOOD-INVOICE, then look for PO in body, then PDF OCR. If PO still missing, tag as "requires manual review" and notify supplier with failure code F-PO-MISSING.
- Auto-ACK on success: RW-ACK-<YYYYMMDD>-<8hex> (store in ingestion metadata)

2) PO mapping (Monica)
- If vendor sends multiple PO lines, map line items to ledger by supplier-provided commodity code (use onboarding form field 6). If commodity code absent, default to 'misc services' GL 4500 and route to AP review.

3) Subject prefix enforcement
- We can accept variations but canonical form should be enforced by parser. If prefix missing, parser will still try to match PO via OCR but will lower confidence score and queue for manual.

4) ACK retries and idempotency
- If duplicate file with same filename and identical checksum arrives within 24h, return same ACK token. If different checksum, create new ingestion record and return new ACK.

Monica please draft mapping table for multi-PO invoices and share template fields we need the vendor to fill. I'll take the call with Acme and confirm final subject wording.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier billing intake — onboarding form + email fallback? (regex + routing)

Thanks Vanessa — reviewed. Confirming the technical pieces we should land on the call: 

1) Regex for subject prefix (first pass): \bREDWOOD-INVOICE\s+([A-Z0-9-]+)\s+PO-?(\d{5,12})\b
   - Group 1 -> vendor_id, Group 2 -> PO number
   - We will log regex matches with a confidence score (0-1). If confidence < 0.7, route to manual review.

2) Vendor_id verification
- Yes: lookup vendor_id in the vendor table before auto-accept. If no match, reject with F-VENDOR-NOTFOUND and include link to onboarding form to update vendor ID. That keeps AP noise down.

3) ACK token generation details OK
- We should namespace ACKs per ingestion cluster (RW-ACK-<cluster>-<YYYYMMDD>-<8hex>) so multi-region duplicates are avoidable. I'll add the cluster prefix to the spec.

4) Edgecases: multi-PO single PDF
- If multiple PO numbers are present, create one ingestion record per PO and attach the same PDF as "shared document". Monica please confirm GL mapping behavior for split allocations.

I'll join the call and bring the parsing logs for current email fallback tests.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Platform Engineer, Ingest & Routing
